text:
maria_cs: Hey all — kicking off onboarding for Beryl Health (Anita, cc'd). Primary success criteria for first 30 days: 1) Prod API access and test calls, 2) SSO configured, 3) First integration flow passing smoke tests. Can we align owners and target dates?

sam_se: I can own the API onboarding + postman collection. Proposed target: API smoke by day 7.

ravi_eng: We'll prioritize a dedicated staging pool. Need Anita to confirm expected QPS and sample payloads. Can we get that by EOD Thu?

anita_beryl: Confirmed — initial QPS ~50, burst to 200 during peak tests. I'll drop sample payloads to this thread by EOD.

leah_sec: Quick security checklist: SSO SAML metadata, IP allowlist, KMS requirements. I can run a 30-min call next Tue to walk through gaps.

jordy_pm: High-level timeline suggestion: Day 0–7 API + creds, Day 8–14 SSO + access controls, Day 15–30 integration smoke & acceptance. Thoughts? :calendar:

onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist created -> /onboard/BERYL-001 (assigned to maria_cs).

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Action items: sam -> API smoke by 7 (sam_se), ravi -> staging pool by 5 (ravi_eng), leah -> security call Tue (leah_sec), anita -> payloads by Thu (anita_beryl). I'll send a 15-min sync invite for Tue at 10am and a shared README. :thumbsup:
